[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

Overview: Automated ÄKTA Pure chromatography run with manual sample loading followed by execution of a predefined protocol on the ÄKTA system. UV and conductivity signals were recorded during the run.

3.1 Workflow Description
  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The run was initiated with a manual step to fill the sample loop as prompted by the workflow ("Manually fill sample loop").
    • After confirming that the sample loop was filled, the automated protocol continued.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Protocol Execution
    • The AKTA Pure system executed the configured chromatography protocol.
    • UV signal (channel: uv1) and conductivity (channel: cond) were continuously monitored and recorded throughout the run.
    • Sampling interval for process data acquisition: 1 s.
3.2 Run Parameters

The following run parameters were applied during the chromatography process (where configured in the workflow):

Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the executed chromatography process.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Total time used for column equilibration.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate applied during the equilibration phase.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Time during which the sample was loaded/injected onto the column.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate applied during sample loading/injection.
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient.
Elution Gradient Start (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer B percentage of the elution gradient.
Elution Gradient End (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer B percentage of the elution gradient.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of the post-elution wash step.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate applied during the wash step.
CIP Duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Total duration of the cleaning-in-place (CIP) step.
CIP Step 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during CIP step 2.
CIP Step 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 3.
CIP Step 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 4.
CIP Step 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 5.
